description: Search 100M+ chemical compounds by name, formula, or SMILES string. Returns CID, molecular formula, weight, IUPAC name, SMILES, InChI, XLogP, H-bond donors/acceptors, exact mass, and complexity. The largest public chemical database (PubChem / NCBI)

name.description: Compound name, formula, or SMILES string (e.g. "aspirin", "C9H8O4", "CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O")

name: chemistry.pubchem.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Chemical Compounds
